notes: Illustrative assumptions, not calibrated Conley operations. Published 2025 context lists 2 modernized 50ft berths and 3 new STS cranes commissioned in 2021; the total active/staffed crane fleet is not established. The scenario uses 3 available cranes and 10 tractors as assumptions. The 18 crane moves/hour, draft limit, vessel length, yard slots, dwell and transport cycle are assumptions rather than measured service or navigational limits. Annual Conley boxes exclude over-the-road volumes. No Guam size mix is inferred. 168h/24h and recommendation replication screens are prototype choices, not industry standards.
